---
title: "Mingyang Liu"
subtitle: "Empirical asset pricing · characteristic-based factor models · portfolio choice"
---

PhD in Finance, Imperial College London.

I study the step between estimating a characteristic-based factor model and using it to choose stock holdings: how the inputs to an investment rule, not only the model's forecasts, shape what an investor ends up holding.

::: {.paper-card}
<div class="kicker">Job market paper</div>
### Characteristic Libraries and Portfolio Decisions
Adding characteristics to a library changes how a model represents information more than how much it has. The paper keeps its negative results explicit rather than equating redundancy with absence of pricing information.
